notes.title: Patch 1.1.5: New localizations, optimizations, improved controls for left-handed
notes.content:
This update adds support for Hindi and Arabic languages, improves gameplay stability, and enhances controls for left-handed players. This makes our game accessible to players from different cultural and linguistic backgrounds. We also increased stability and smoothness of the gameplay by reducing the amount of real-time shader loadings and calculations. The controls for left-handed players have been made more convenient: right Ctrl is for interaction, and right Shift is for sprinting. These changes do not affect the core gameplay and are aimed at improving the overall gaming experience.

Have a great day and enjoy the game,
Neon Flamingo Games

notes.title: Update 1.1: "Lisa's Insanity"
notes.content:
In this update, you will experience the desperation and fear that Lisa feels, finding herself at the very center of a nightmare where reality and illusions intertwine. The consequences of a nervous breakdown and time spent in the hospital will make themselves known.
Will Lisa be able to overcome the fears she must face on her journey? Can she maintain her sanity when every step leads into the unknown?
Together with Lisa, you will need to figure out what is real in this story and what is merely a ghost of her own mind. Find the right path in the new update, "Lisa's Insanity".

Yours sincerely,
Neon Flamingo Games

notes.title: Hotfix, version 1.0.1: .NET Framework 3.5
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to read the localization database on systems that did not support .NET Framework 3.5.
Some users encountered a situation where localization strings were missing in the game, instead of which they could see localization codes. This problem caused the game to behave incorrectly.
In this hotfix we have removed the dependency on .NET Framework 3.5.

Thanks to everyone who reacted to this problem - this allowed us to release a fix as soon as possible.

Enjoy the game and have a nice day,
 Neon Flamingo Games
